name: Zero Raw JSX / Unsafe HTML Injection Guard
description: Audits modified TypeScript and React files to ensure no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, eval(), or raw LLM HTML/JSX evaluation bypasses the @json-render Spec pipeline.

action.prompt: Audit the saved file against Invariant 1 (No-JSX / No-HTML Law in .kiro/steering/genui-invariants.md). Confirm that dangerouslySetInnerHTML, eval(), new Function(), and unvalidated raw HTML strings are not used, and that all dynamic UI rendering flows through @json-render Spec validation.
